_meta.title: SLATE car factory options, delivery lead times, seats and cargo: real published figures
_meta.rules: Every non-null figure was read from the cited source on the date in read. Prices are in the local currency in whole units (not cents). US and Canadian prices exclude sales tax; British, Irish and Mexican prices include VAT/IVA (Irish includes VRT). Where the maker could not be read, the source names the secondary site. Unfound figures are null with the reason in a note. US cargo volumes were converted from cubic feet at 28.3168 L per cu ft, with the original in the note.
